title: Eric on Sol Price: 'he eventually arrived at work to find the locks changed'
summary: Price spent more than twenty years building FedMart on low prices and high wages, and lost it to investors who wanted the opposite. The clip is cut from Eric's conversation with Maria Rotilu on The Startup Leap.
blockquote: Despite years of fighting to protect his principles, he eventually arrived at work to find the locks changed. He had been fired from the company he built.
